text: A Song of the Ascents. 1 Out of the depths I have called out to You, O YHWH!
O Lord, listen to my voice! Let Your ears be attentive to the voice of my supplications!
If You were to mark iniquities, O YAH, O Lord, who could stand?
But with You [is] forgiveness, so that You may be feared.
I wait for YHWH; my soul waits, and in His word I have hoped.
My soul [is] for the Lord, more than those watching for the morning, watching for the morning.
Look with hope, O Israel, unto YHWH! For with YHWH is loving devotion, and redemption [is] abundant with Him.
And He will redeem Israel from all his iniquities.
